external_boundaries.content: Shared published package names and version constraints plus ordinary package-index request metadata. Client files, prompts, case data and generated work are not included in installer requests. Workflow arguments stay in the local child process.
controls: Only published shared requirements are installed, never requirements derived from client material or prompts.
One fixed environment outside plugin source and client folders is reused across products and modules. Explicitly approved OCR is retained in the same environment.

A reader lease prevents setup from modifying packages while managed workflows run. Setup validates dependencies before writing the readiness receipt. Failed updates leave execution unavailable until repair.
Older plugin policies cannot downgrade an environment created by a newer shared policy revision.
external_boundaries.destination: Python Package Index (PyPI) or the index selected by the user's Python configuration
external_boundaries.purpose: Prepare the published shared Vera, Clara and Lucia core dependencies, and validate the selected workflow, in one user-scoped Python 3.12 environment per operating-system host.

external_boundaries.content: The fixed CPython 3.12 version request, operating-system and architecture selection, and ordinary download request metadata. Setup does not read client files or add prompts, case material or generated reports to this request.
controls: Use an installed CPython 3.12 when available; otherwise use uv or automatically download the published uv 0.12.10 wheel, verify its pinned SHA-256, and provision private CPython 3.12 without changing system Python or shell profiles.
Probe the selected interpreter before creating the dependency environment; never fall back to executing workflows with another Python minor version.
A failed download or interpreter probe stops setup; existing environments and client files remain intact.
external_boundaries.destination: Astral python-build-standalone CPython distributions on GitHub, or the Python download mirror explicitly configured in uv
external_boundaries.purpose: Provision the declared CPython 3.12 workflow interpreter when absent, automatically bootstrapping uv if needed

classes.content: Research scene images or user-supplied real-estate photographs; supplied reports, listing material, figures, maps, statistics, labels, property facts and qualifications; accepted Vera visuals and review artifacts when handed off; source-basis references; audience, story objective, narration language, scene order, output format and optional on-screen text
classes.purpose: Select and order approved scenes and write source-faithful narration

classes.content: Scene plan, narration, language, hash-bound Mparanza voice request and returned OpenAI audio artifacts, hosted bundle manifest, localized AI-voice disclosure, visual and optional local-music fingerprints, scene order, landscape/vertical/square format, on-screen text, motion and music-mix choices, approval record, captions, timing, render report, media QA, caveats and final review findings
classes.purpose: Prepare, review and validate the narrated research video

classes.content: Retained local attempt directories and published snapshots can contain copies of research scenes or property photographs, intermediate/final video, normalized narration audio, locally mixed background music, captions, on-screen text, narration and approval records, source references, filenames/local paths, process stdout/stderr and prior reports. These copies remain until separately removed; retry does not automatically delete them. Any of this material explicitly opened by Codex can enter model context. Images and music are not part of the hosted narration request.
classes.purpose: Inspect failed renders, verify the complete published generation and preserve review evidence

de: Codex oder Cowork kann ausgewählte Quellen, Forschungsszenen oder Immobilienfotos lesen; nach der Freigabe erreichen nur Sprechertext, Sprache, Szenenkennungen und Bindungs-Hashes den authentifizierten Mparanza-Dienst und OpenAI. Ein Nutzer-API-Schlüssel ist nicht erforderlich.

Das ausgewählte Modell in Codex oder Cowork kann die Forschungsquellen, freigegebene Vera-Visualisierungen und deren Prüfartefakte, Immobilienfotos und ausgewählte Exposé-Angaben lesen, darunter sichtbare Texte, Merkmale, Abbildungen, Karten, Statistiken und Einschränkungen, außerdem Szenenreihenfolge, Quer-, Hoch- oder Quadratformat, Bildschirmtext, Zielgruppe, Sprache, Entwurf des Sprechertexts, Quellenbelege, Auswahl lokaler Musik und Prüfentscheidungen. Es erfolgt keine automatische Anonymisierung. Nach ausdrücklicher Bestätigung enthält die auf der authentifizierten Mparanza-Seite hochgeladene Datei nur freigegebenen Sprechertext, Sprache, Szenenkennungen sowie Plan- und Freigabe-Hashes; Bilder, Quellen, Quellenbelege, Vera-Artefakte, Musik und lokale Pfade werden nicht hochgeladen. Mparanza verwendet eigene Zugangsdaten, um den Sprechertext an OpenAI zu senden, erstellt die Antwort im Arbeitsspeicher und speichert weder Anfrage noch Audio im Anwendungsspeicher. Die Verarbeitung bei OpenAI folgt Mparanzas Anbietervereinbarung; diese Funktion nennt keine OpenAI-Aufbewahrungsfrist. Der lokale Renderer validiert die Hashes, liest die vollständigen Bilder und Musikdateien und erzeugt KI-Stimmenhinweis, Bildschirmtext, Untertitel, Poster, Video und Berichte.
en: Codex or Cowork may read selected sources, research scenes, or property photographs; after approval, only narration, language, scene identifiers, and binding hashes reach the authenticated Mparanza service and OpenAI. No user API key is required.

The selected model in Codex or Cowork may read the chosen research sources, accepted Vera visuals and their review artifacts, property photographs and listing material, including visible text, features, figures, maps, statistics, and qualifications, together with scene order, landscape, vertical or square format, on-screen text, audience, language, narration draft, source-basis notes, local-music choice, and review decisions. No automatic anonymization is applied. After explicit confirmation, the file uploaded to the authenticated Mparanza page contains only approved narration, language, scene identifiers, and plan and approval hashes; images, sources, source-basis notes, Vera artifacts, music, and local paths are not uploaded. Mparanza uses its own credential to send the narration to OpenAI, builds the response in memory, and does not save the request or audio to application storage. Processing at OpenAI follows Mparanza's provider arrangement; this function does not state an OpenAI retention period. The local renderer validates the hashes, reads the complete images and music, and generates the AI-voice disclosure, on-screen text, captions, poster, video, and reports.
es: Codex o Cowork puede leer las fuentes, escenas de investigación o fotografías inmobiliarias seleccionadas; tras la aprobación, solo la narración, el idioma, los identificadores de escena y los hashes de vinculación llegan al servicio autenticado de Mparanza y a OpenAI. No se requiere una clave API del usuario.

El modelo seleccionado en Codex o Cowork puede leer las fuentes de investigación, los visuales aceptados de Vera y sus artefactos de revisión, las fotografías inmobiliarias y el material del anuncio elegidos, incluidos textos, características, figuras, mapas, estadísticas y matices visibles, además del orden de las escenas, el formato horizontal, vertical o cuadrado, el texto en pantalla, el público, el idioma, el borrador de narración, las notas sobre las fuentes, la elección de música local y las decisiones de revisión. No se aplica anonimización automática. Tras la confirmación explícita, el archivo subido a la página autenticada de Mparanza contiene únicamente la narración aprobada, el idioma, los identificadores de escena y los hashes del plan y de la aprobación; no se suben imágenes, fuentes, notas de respaldo, artefactos de Vera, música ni rutas locales. Mparanza usa su propia credencial para enviar la narración a OpenAI, construye la respuesta en memoria y no guarda la solicitud ni el audio en el almacenamiento de la aplicación. El tratamiento en OpenAI depende del acuerdo de proveedor de Mparanza; esta función no declara un período de conservación de OpenAI. El renderizador local valida los hashes, lee las imágenes y la música completas y genera el aviso de voz de IA, el texto en pantalla, los subtítulos, el póster, el vídeo y los informes.
fr: Codex ou Cowork peut lire les sources, scènes de recherche ou photographies immobilières sélectionnées ; après approbation, seuls la narration, la langue, les identifiants de scène et les empreintes de liaison parviennent au service Mparanza authentifié et à OpenAI. Aucune clé API utilisateur n'est requise.

Le modèle sélectionné dans Codex ou Cowork peut lire les sources de recherche, les visuels acceptés de Vera et leurs artefacts de revue, les photographies immobilières et les éléments d'annonce choisis, notamment les textes, caractéristiques, figures, cartes, statistiques et réserves visibles, ainsi que l'ordre des scènes, le format paysage, vertical ou carré, le texte à l'écran, le public, la langue, le projet de narration, les notes sur les sources, le choix de musique locale et les décisions de revue. Aucune anonymisation automatique n'est appliquée. Après confirmation explicite, le fichier chargé sur la page Mparanza authentifiée contient uniquement la narration approuvée, la langue, les identifiants de scène et les empreintes du plan et de l'approbation ; les images, sources, notes justificatives, artefacts Vera, musique et chemins locaux ne sont pas chargés. Mparanza utilise sa propre clé pour envoyer la narration à OpenAI, construit la réponse en mémoire et n'enregistre ni la demande ni l'audio dans le stockage de l'application. Le traitement chez OpenAI relève de l'accord fournisseur de Mparanza ; cette fonction ne déclare aucune durée de conservation OpenAI. Le moteur local valide les empreintes, lit les images et la musique complètes et génère la mention de voix IA, le texte à l'écran, les sous-titres, l'affiche, la vidéo et les rapports.
it: Codex o Cowork può leggere fonti, scene di ricerca o fotografie immobiliari selezionate; dopo l'approvazione, solo narrazione, lingua, identificativi delle scene e hash di controllo arrivano al servizio Mparanza autenticato e a OpenAI. Non serve una chiave API dell'utente.

Il modello selezionato in Codex o Cowork può leggere le fonti di ricerca, le visuali approvate provenienti da Vera con i relativi artefatti di revisione, le fotografie immobiliari e il materiale dell'annuncio scelti, inclusi testo, caratteristiche, figure, mappe, statistiche e qualificazioni visibili, oltre a ordine delle scene, formato orizzontale, verticale o quadrato, testo in sovrimpressione, pubblico, lingua, bozza della narrazione, note sulla base documentale, scelta della musica locale e decisioni di revisione. Non viene applicata anonimizzazione automatica. Dopo la conferma esplicita, il file caricato sulla pagina Mparanza autenticata contiene soltanto testo approvato, lingua, identificativi delle scene e hash del piano e dell'approvazione; immagini, fonti, note sulla base documentale, artefatti Vera, musica e percorsi locali non vengono caricati. Mparanza usa una credenziale propria per inviare la narrazione a OpenAI, costruisce la risposta in memoria e non salva richiesta o audio nello storage dell'applicazione. Il trattamento presso OpenAI dipende dall'accordo del fornitore di Mparanza; questa funzione non dichiara un periodo di conservazione OpenAI. Il renderer locale convalida gli hash, legge immagini e musica complete e genera avviso sulla voce IA, testo in sovrimpressione, sottotitoli, poster, video e rapporti.

security_controls.control: The request, attachment and rendering steps verify explicit user-confirmation evidence for the approved plan, narration script, scene order, output format, on-screen text, localized AI-voice disclosure, review packet and every visual and local-music SHA-256. Music requires an explicit rights-confirmation field. The hosted request is created only after approval and includes the approval and plan hashes.

The local attachment step requires the Mparanza hosted source, fixed provider policy, exact request, approval, language and scene order; rejects unsafe or undeclared ZIP entries; converts returned WAV files to normalized PCM; and binds their SHA-256, metadata and duration to the run.
